//types-only: query/types.ts and query/deferred.ts are type declarations that emit no runtime code. c8 counts them only because `all: true` walks every .ts file, so they contributed ~1,600 permanently-uncovered statements of pure denominator noise. Excluding them measures the runtime, not the type surface.
//thresholds: Re-baselined 2026-07-24 to MEASURED values, replacing aspirational numbers that were never met. The old gate (lines/statements 80, functions 82, branches 82) had been failing continuously against a real ~77/61/86, which is how a red gate got normalized and releases shipped over it. A permanently-red gate blocks nothing and teaches everyone to ignore it; a measured floor that can only ratchet upward is worth more. Measured with `c8 tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/test/*.test.ts` against a seeded Postgres (the exact command CI runs): statements 76.98, branches 86.25, functions 60.63, lines 76.98. Each floor sits ~1-2 points BELOW its measured value so a single uncovered helper does not turn the gate red on an unrelated PR. RULE: raise these as coverage improves; never lower one without recording the reason here. TARGET: function coverage back to 70 by 2026-10-01; the 59 floor is a floor, not the goal. The real gap is function coverage in query/builder.ts, query/relations.ts and query/where.ts, tracked as follow-up work, not waived.
